decisions.reason: This lever handle family sits close to the core range and remained on the website in 2019 while sister lines were removed, so as one of the surviving design investments it is likely to be kept rather than written off.

This single handle design is part of the established fittings offer and stayed listed after others were pruned, so management will likely keep it, though as one design among many it is somewhat more expendable.

The L700 LightAccess system is a publicly promoted flagship with substantial engineering investment and central to the announced move into digital building organization, so management would persist and attribute any weak results to market ramp-up.
